about: Reading record for the Beta-Alanine Lab: one entry per paper read, wanted or known only secondhand, plus a log of searches and what they found, so the literature review is not repeated. Numbers the page uses live in claims.csv, loading_observations.csv, washout_rates.csv and solubility.csv; this file says what each paper is, what was read, what it feeds and what it leaves open. The spec checks it against the manifest and those CSVs.
verified: Every DOI, volume and first page checked against Crossref on 2026-11-15; six were wrong when written from memory and are corrected.

searches.question: Has anyone measured or estimated endogenous beta-alanine synthesis during supplementation?
tried: plasma beta-aminoisobutyric acid, uracil, dihydropyrimidine in supplementation trials
deuterium or 13C beta-alanine tracer carnosine synthesis
metabolomics urine or plasma during supplementation
feedback hypothesis in Harris, Derave, Saunders papers
searches.found: No human measurement. Rat UPB1 is feedback-inhibited by beta-alanine (matthews1987) but human UPB1 is not at 10 mM (sakamoto2001). No DPD inhibition reported. Fasting plasma rises during supplementation (debrandt2022, blancquaert2017, blancquaert2018). Only estimate is Spelnikov's model figure. Chicken metabolomics (PLoS One 2022) found 3-aminoisobutyrate up; animal only. NCT07404540 lists plasma metabolites, no results posted.

searches.question: Why do low doses beat the linear model (Stegen 2014, Blancquaert 2018)?
tried: saturable TauT PAT1 Km dose efficiency
searches.found: Transporter Km about 40 uM (bakardjiev1994 via harris2006) against plasma peaks of 47 to 833 uM: large plain servings saturate uptake. Mouse transaminase threshold (blancquaert2016) points the other way. No human Km; no head-to-head efficiency study by dose.

searches.question: Why does loading slow after week 12 (Saunders 2017)?
searches.found: TauT mRNA down in humans (saunders2017), up in mice (everaert2013). Muscle histidine falls 31.6% on 6 g/day (blancquaert2017), untested as a cause. Perim 2019: no known reports of saturation in humans.

searches.question: Does insulin explain the meal effect?
searches.found: No in human muscle (goncalves2020); yes at 350 uM but not 700 uM in mouse cells (santos2021).

searches.question: Is there a human GADL1 share of beta-alanine synthesis?
searches.found: Only genetic association and low in vitro activity (mahootchi2020); no share by route.

searches.question: What do the seven papers asked for in Phase 7 actually say, against what was read secondhand?
tried: full text of sakamoto2001, matthews1987, bakardjiev1994, debrandt2022, blancquaert2017, goncalves2020, perim2019
searches.found: Secondhand reading held, with corrections: Blancquaert 2017 fasting rise is +172% (De Brandt says +169%); Sakamoto tested 10 mM on crude extract with 0.2 mM substrate; Bakardjiev Km is from embryonic chick cells and taurine nearly abolishes uptake. Perim judges histidine depletion not limiting, which weakens it as the slowdown cause. New leads: varanoske2019 (formulation), painelli2018 (endogenous supply rising with training).

searches.question: What do Varanoske 2019 and Painelli 2018 show?
searches.found: Varanoske: SR +50.1%, RR +37.9% at 6 g/day for 28 days, both inside the model band, model line between them. Painelli: HIIT raised carnosine 15.8 to 20.6 mmol/kg dm in vegetarians with no beta-alanine intake, genes unchanged. Both arrived with the earlier batch and were missed by a check for expected filenames.

searches.question: Is there newer or overlooked work on loading, washout, uptake kinetics, urine at steady state, uracil flux, or TauT?
tried: population PK or Michaelis-Menten uptake models
human uracil catabolism flux in g/day
searches.found: New: nemezio2021 (inactive muscle loads as well as active), varanoske2017 (men and women), harris2009 DOI, harris2008. Matthews 2025 obesity trial did not measure carnosine. No PK model, no steady-state 24 h urine study, no uracil flux figure, no TauT knockout carnosine data. One search summary misattributed carnosine synthase Km (1.0-2.3 mM) as a muscle uptake Km; discarded.

searches.question: What do Nemezio 2021, Varanoske 2017 and the two Harris FASEB abstracts show?
tried: full text of nemezio2021 and varanoske2017
abstract text of harris2008 and harris2009 pasted by the user
searches.found: Nemezio: inactive and active muscle loaded similarly, against Bex. Varanoske 2017: no clear sex difference in loading, histidine unchanged. Harris 2009 confirms the values already in the fit (+15.4, t1/2 8.6 wk); Harris 2008 plasma peaks fit Decombaz. The FASEB abstracts are acknowledged with caveats and give no new claims.

searches.question: Is Ghent MRS carnosine in mM per kg wet muscle or per liter of muscle water, and over what window is Baguet 2009's 0.21 mM/wk?
tried: full text of baguet2009, stegen2013, stegen2014, blancquaert2017, blancquaert2018, baguet2012
searches.found: Baguet 2009: 0.21 mM/wk is linear over the 9-week washout (0.57 mM at 3 wk, 31.8% of the gain; baseline by 9 wk; first order would leave 34.3%). Unit basis: every Ghent paper quantifies against the water signal and defers to Baguet 2010 or Ozdemir 2007 for the mM calculation; neither is archived, so the basis is not settled.

searches.question: Does Stellingwerff 2012 or Spelnikov 2019 give the high-low arm's week 8 carnosine in absolute units?
tried: full text of stellingwerff2012 (Results, Week 8; Fig. 3)
searches.found: No. Spelnikov's table stops the high-low arm at day 28; Stellingwerff gives week 8 only as percent rises (high-low TA 30.3%, GA 44.5%; low-low 21.9%, 35.5%) and in Fig. 3. Percents times the pooled baselines overshoot the low-low arm's absolute value (9.45 against 7.53 dm), so no mmol point was added; the ratio of the two arms is an anchor instead.

openQuestions.question: Does supplementation lower endogenous beta-alanine synthesis in people?
openQuestions.status: No measurement exists (searched 2026-11-15). Indirect: human UPB1 not inhibited (sakamoto2001); fasting plasma rises (blancquaert2017, debrandt2022). Would need a tracer or uracil-catabolite study.

openQuestions.question: Can endogenous supply rise on demand?
openQuestions.status: Yes in one study: HIIT raised carnosine by 4.8 mmol/kg dm in vegetarians eating no beta-alanine (painelli2018); synthesis itself not measured.

openQuestions.question: Does a flatter plasma curve store more per gram (the low-dose gap)?
openQuestions.status: varanoske2019: sustained release +50.1% vs rapid +37.9% at the same 6 g/day, not significantly different; both inside the model band. Suggestive, not settled. No human uptake Km exists.

openQuestions.question: Why does loading slow (Saunders week 24, Blancquaert 2017 by day 23)?
openQuestions.status: TauT down in humans (saunders2017); histidine ruled out by dolan2019 and perim2019. No paper sizes the slowdown. No study measured carnosine in TauT knockout muscle (searched 2026-11-16).
